title: Lego 75879 | Scuderia Ferrari SF16 H | 3D Product Review
description:
Join the Scuderia Ferrari team with this cool LEGO® Speed Champions set! Prepare the Scuderia Ferrari SF16-H with the wrench. Pick your favorite race number and helmet and power away from the start-finish line. Check the race data on the monitor at the pit wall, talk tactics on the walkie-talkie and race to be first past the checkered flag!
